As an example, the test scenarios outlined below capture the various aspects of functionality to test for the given requirement:

A customer can login to an ecommerce website with a valid username and password

Test Scenarios:

  1. Validate that only registered users are allowed to login
  2. Validate that unregistered users are asked to register
  3. Validate that only registered users can request a password reset
Multiple test scenarios can be created for a single requirement, business process, use case or user story. Test scenarios typically have a one-to-many relationship with test cases.
To specify the functionality components of a target solution that require testing.
In addition, to a high-level verification statement, a test scenario often contains an identification number that maps to the respective requirement, business process, use case or user story.
